prior_year_events.impact_description: Large addition of gross reserves via Reinsurance to Close (RITC) taken on during the year (gross GBP 701,118k) which materially affected the claims reserves and reinsurance position.
Entrusted 50% quota share with Cavello Bay (effective October 2019) leading to increased reinsurance recoveries which drove positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 gross claims outstanding at the prior year balance (31/12/2018) were GBP 1,331.49m. The movement in prior year provisions on a gross basis was an increase of GBP 14.053m (a small strengthening). The net picture shows a large net release driven by reinsurance recoveries and a significant RITC taken on during the year; the Cavello Bay 50% quota share arrangement also increased reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves and gross prior year movement taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) and the Technical Provisions note (Change in prior year provisions) respectively. The 'Change in prior year provisions' gross figure is explicit in the Technical Provisions table. The financial statements include large RITC amounts and quota-share reinsurance (Cavello Bay) which materially affect the reinsurance column and net movements; this distorts net figures and explains the large net release despite a small gross strengthening. The gross claims development triangle is present but some development-period cells in the scanned image are partially blank; the triangle was transcribed where legible. Gross premium mix contains small negative published class amounts (as printed) which cause percentages to slightly exceed 100% for the 'Other' category.
